description_short: List all rare-earth ALD/MLD hybrid films that achieve high growth per cycle (GPC ≥ 5 Å) at low deposition temperature (≤ 250 °C); report material system, metal precursor family, organic precursor, GPC, and temperature.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

numeric_parsing.gpc: GPC values are treated as strings; the first numeric value is extracted using a regular expression (e.g. '2.5–3.2' → 2.5) and cast to xsd:decimal as ?gpc_num.
numeric_parsing.temperature: Deposition temperature strings are parsed similarly; the first numeric token (e.g. '160–280' → 160) is used as ?temp_num.

postprocessing_notes.family_classification: The metal precursor is lowercased and inspected for ligand tags '(dpdmg)', '(thd)', '(amd)', '(famd)', '(guan)'; these are mapped to simple families 'R(dpdmg)3', 'R(thd)3', 'R(amd)3', 'R(famd)3', 'R(guan)3'. All others fall into 'other'.
postprocessing_notes.output_columns: The query returns a human-readable material system, metal precursor label, organic precursor label, a coarse metal-precursor family, and numeric GPC and temperature values, sorted by family, GPC, and material.
